guarantees.claim: While rst_ni is low, new_q and clean_q are forced to 1'b0 asynchronously on negedge rst_ni.
On each rising edge of clk_i when rst_ni is high, new_q is updated with the value of new_d and clean_q with the value of clean_d.

assumptions.claim: new_d and clean_d must be stable before and after the rising edge of clk_i to meet setup/hold requirements.
assumptions.risk: Metastable capture on new_q or clean_q, leading to incorrect status values that software/hardware may rely on.

uncertain_points.claim: The interpretation of the 'clean' status bit (clean_q) is defined outside this chunk; if it indicates that secret material has been wiped, a premature assertion of clean_d without a full clear could compromise security.
uncertain_points.risk: False sense of security if wipe is incomplete, potentially leaving secret data accessible.
